Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

abilities.name: Palm Vortex
_curatorNotes: Tap E (Palm Vortex Initial Storm): hitmark=34f, 316.8% ATK Anemo at lvl=10 (skillInitialStorm). 2 Anemo particles per cast (0.6s ICD).
Cooldown: SetCDWithDelay(skill, 5*60, hitmark-5=29). Tap-E CD is 5s.

Hold-E variant: skillHoldDelayFrames + hitmark of 31 + 5×15 + 5 = 121f baseline (final-Storm happens at 116f after the 6 cutting ticks). 8s cooldown when fully held (≥2 ticks). Authored as variant with input ['hE'] + cooldown:8. Frame values approximated.
Tap-E frames (Male): skillPressFrames[0]=InitAbilSlice(74), ActionBurst=76 ActionDash=30 ActionJump=31 ActionSwap=66.

Anemo absorption: during Hold-E (and burst Gust Surge), Traveler scans for nearby auras to absorb. Once absorbed, subsequent ticks deal absorbed-element DMG instead of Anemo. Same multi-element-absorption gap as Wanderer/Kazuha; not modeled.

[A7] Hold variant per-tick damage and its 6-tick continuous-cutting + final-Storm sequence (first tick ~31f, +15f intervals, +5f Initial→Max transition) are not modeled as separate hits; the variant's timing is approximate. Frame breakdown already in _curatorNotes.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — Absorption half: the Hold's seven authored application entries all read anemo, so every aura-lane pip and every swirl marker during a hold-E is Anemo where the game would show Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro — rubric N13 says these stay fully true. Timing half: the variant's own frames are stamped 'approximated' in the curator notes, so the hold-E bar's WIDTH and where the next token lands are a guess — a bar length the player reads directly. Dropped clause: 'individual cutting ticks aren't shown' — no cast on any character shows sub-hits, and it is already stated tool-level in AURA_NOTES. Category: visible-divergence.
abilities.description:
Aether/Lumine summons a vortex of wind, drawing enemies and objects in toward herself.

Tap
Unleashes a small wind vortex that deals Anemo DMG to opponents in front of her.

Hold
The whirlwind continuously sucks in surrounding objects and opponents, dealing continuous Anemo DMG. After releasing, the whirlwind strikes again, causing AoE Anemo DMG and launching opponents.

abilities.name: Gust Surge
abilities.caveat: Not modeled: the tornado absorbing a nearby Cryo, Pyro, Hydro, or Electro aura, after which each tick adds a hit of that element — only its Anemo ticks are shown.
_curatorNotes: 9 ticks at burstHitmarks[0]=94 + 30*i (i=0..8): 67.68% ATK Anemo per tick at lvl=10 (burstDot). Total burst-window = 334f = 5.57s. Authored as summons[] with summonTick interval 0.5s (30f), firstTickDelay 0.
Burst frames: burstFrames[0]=InitAbilSlice(110), ActionSkill=109 ActionDash=96 ActionJump=96 ActionSwap=100. Per Q-spec swap/N/E/D/J.
Cooldown: SetCD(burst, 15*60). EnergyMax=60. ConsumeEnergy(3) drains 3 energy from teammates.
'grouping' tag added (capability sweep 2026-07-28): the tornado pulls in objects and opponents (kit text, genshin-db combat3). Tag-only — no numeric effect, pull is part of the burst's hit window.

C6 note removed (capability sweep 2026-07-28): a stale note here claimed a +60% party RES buff on Swirl — not the live kit. The real C6 (Intertwined Winds, anemo resShred on burst hits) is authored on the constellation entry.

A6 rigor 2026-07-12: summon duration corrected 5.57 → 4.03 (gcsim burst.go). The renderer adds duration to spawnsAt=94 (endAt=spawnAt+duration), so 5.57s — gcsim's from-CAST status window (334f) mis-set as from-SPAWN — drew 12 tick markers for a 9-tick burst. Male status 336f − spawn 94f = 242f = 4.03s renders the correct 9 ticks (last tick 4.0s < 4.03s; strict-< needs >4.0).
[A7] The additional absorbed-element hit deals 50% of base Anemo DMG (varies by element); the tornado can absorb at any of its 9 ticks. Only the Anemo per-tick damage is shown as summon ticks.
nonHitting (non-hitting casts round, 2026-09-16 (docs/nonhitting-casts-round.md §1)): gcsim traveler/common/anemo/burst.go:81: the tornado ticks from f94 are the Gust Surge series.
abilities.description: Aether/Lumine summons a swirling tornado that pulls enemies and objects toward itself, dealing continuous Anemo DMG. The tornado may absorb the elements of Hydro, Pyro, Cryo, or Electro it comes into contact with, dealing additional Elemental DMG of that type.

passives.name: Slitting Wind
_curatorNotes: A1: last hit of normal-attack combo (N5) fires an additional Slitting Wind: 60% ATK Anemo. gcsim a1() in asc.go gates on c.NormalCounter == c.NormalHitNum-1 + a1Hitmark[gender] (Male=19, Female=21). Per-hit Effect trigger needed; not authored. Could be authored as an onCast normal-trigger-with-N5-condition but the schema's onCast trigger doesn't have a chain-stage variant for normals.

passives.name: Second Wind
_curatorNotes: A4 heal authored (capability sweep 2026-07-28): gcsim traveler/common/anemo/asc.go:47-80 — on Palm Vortex kill (skill AttackTag check asc.go:59-61), 5 ticks of HealTypePercent 0.02 self at 1s intervals (asc.go:68-77), ICD 300f (asc.go:66). Authored as one manual 2% Max HP tick with procCooldown 5: no enemy-death trigger primitive exists and per-tick HoT cadence isn't expressible on a manual heal; kill timing is player-added. Supersedes the pre-sweep 'not authored' note.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — It describes an on-kill heal. Two independent reasons there is no pixel: heal effects reach NO timeline surface for any character (grep over src/lib/timeline finds no 'heal' consumer; rubric's C15 correction confirms a heal reaches no buff row), and 'defeats an opponent' is not expressible in notation — the planner has no enemy or HP state. The authored effect is heal/manual/self anyway, which is the largest dead-data class in the corpus. Nothing on screen is wrong or conspicuously blank. Category: invisible-omission.

↻ EFFECT RETIRED 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). passive Second Wind — effects[0] (heal 2% hp, self) carried `trigger: manual` and reached no surface. gcsim: `~/Code/gcsim/internal/characters/traveler/common/anemo/asc.go:47-80` — subscribes to `event.OnTargetDied`, requires the killing blow to be the Traveler's own `AttackTagElementalArt` or `…ArtHold` (`:56-61`), takes a 300f ICD (`:66`), then queues five `HealTypePercent 0.02` self-heals at 1s intervals (`:68-77`). Retained: `_curatorNotes` must keep the gcsim cite and the shape — on a Palm Vortex KILL, 5 × 2% Max HP self-heal at 1s intervals, 5s ICD — and the reason it is retired: the trigger is an opponent's DEATH, and the planner has no enemy, no enemy HP and no notation token for a kill, so there is no trigger to move it to. Keep the 2026-08-19 ruthless-pass note verbatim; its finding (no pixel) is what this verdict acts on. ⚠️ ⛔ Do NOT "rescue" this as `onHit` with `abilityType: 'skill'`. That drops the kill condition, and unlike the planner (where heals draw nothing) the Team Builder turns a `heal` effect into a real facet chip, a badge and a coverage row — it would put the Anemo Traveler into "who can heal" on the strength of a passive that fires only on a kill. `onHPIncrease` / `onHeal` are equally out: the brief lists both as readerless, as dead as `manual`.
passives.description: Palm Vortex kills regenerate 2% HP for 5s. This effect can only occur once every 5s.

constellations.name: Intertwined Winds
constellations.caveat: Only the Anemo shred is shown; if the tornado absorbed an element, that element's RES is also lowered by 20% for 10s.
_curatorNotes: C6 resShred authored (capability sweep 2026-07-28): gcsim traveler/common/anemo/cons.go:24-36 c6cb — ResistMod −0.20 for 600f (10s) per hit; burst.go:77 applies it for Anemo on every Gust Surge hit, burst.go:88 additionally for the absorbed element. Mirrors Venti storm_of_defiance (same mechanic) minus its element-less second effect — absorption is runtime-dynamic, so the absorbed-element shred stays a caveat instead of over-rendering.

Stale beta data corrected per genshin-db (capability sweep 2026-07-28): name 'Crush Mountains and Seas' → 'Intertwined Winds' (id retained for stability); description replaced — the old text framed the second shred as Swirl-gated, but the live kit gates it on Elemental Absorption.
constellations.description:
Targets who take DMG from Gust Surge have their Anemo RES decreased by 20%.
If an Elemental Absorption occurred, then their RES towards the corresponding Element is also decreased by 20%.
